Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and

MODULE: frontend/axis1_evidence_guard.py -- the OUTPUT-side claim-scan + verdict de-overload
(finish-plan step6_a). The OUTPUT mirror of the isolation contract: keeps the simulator from
EMITTING an Axis-1 *_evidence / *_certification manifest that (W-E) overclaims (asserts an exact
channel / PTM / Kraus / teacher-ID / source-timeline / DEM / production result it did not
produce) or (W-J) labels a non-executed contract surface as a passing run. CPU-PURE -- string /
dict structure inspection only; imports collections.abc + typing, NEITHER torch NOR quimb =>
FULL treatment (L0 100% stmt+branch, L1 Hypothesis property, L2 mutmut >= 0.90).
THREE LIVE public units (the AST reconcile of frontend/axis1_evidence_guard.py's top-level
public defs; matches the l3 inventory row 'frontend/axis1_evidence_guard.py -- 3 units (3 C)'):
manifest_is_executed          -- the executed-predicate: a top-level *_executed:True (truthy),
an honest claims_*_execution True anywhere, OR a nested
certification block executed:True (strict bool) with a
backend_contract/evidence_schema/evidence_content_hash
qualifier. Real for/if branches on all three paths.
validate_axis1_evidence_manifest -- the W-E + W-J pre-write gate: (W-E.1) no forbidden
claims_* family key True anywhere; (W-E.2) present-and-False
discipline on evidence/certification schemas; (W-J) verdict
'pass' reserved for EXECUTED evidence. TypeError on non-Mapping;
ValueError on non-bool claim / overclaim / missing-present /
mislabeled verdict; returns a shallow COPY, never mutating.
axis1_contract_verdict        -- the tiny de-overloading helper: invalid -> 'fail'; executed
(backend OR oracle) + valid -> 'pass'; valid non-executed ->
'contract_only'.
DISCRIMINATION (the prior-batch value-vs-shape lesson: certify hit 100% coverage at ~0.75 kill
by asserting verdicts/shapes, not VALUES). Every load-bearing guard here is proved with
assert_discriminates (HOLDS for the real object, FAILS for a named sabotage) AND the load-bearing
POLICY CONSTANTS are value-pinned against an INDEPENDENT hard-coded expected copy: the exact
FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_FAMILIES tuple (order + spelling -- kills every family-string mutation, incl.
the axis2_source_timeline entry that is behaviorally subsumed by 'source_timeline'), the exact
HONEST_EXECUTION_CLAIMS frozenset, the _EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_TOKENS tuple, and the three VERDICT_*
constants. Each forbidden family, each honest claim, and each schema token also has a BEHAVIORAL
parametrized case (a True overclaim rejected / an honest execution accepted / a token schema
requiring present-and-False), and manifest_is_executed is pinned to an INDEPENDENT from-scratch
re-implementation of the executed predicate over Hypothesis-random manifests.
The module's PRIVATE helpers (_normalize_key, _forbidden_family_for, _walk, _iter_nested_mappings,
_is_evidence_or_certification_schema) and its module-level constants are not public units => not
reconciled/scored, but are exercised + mutation-covered via the public units and value-pinned
directly (dash/space/upper key-normalization variants; nested-list overclaim sub_path; the
nested-oracle qualifier keys).
